source_text: Qui solam historiam nominum sequitur, semen sine cultura relinquit. Qui spiritali arte tractat, arbor fit — non pompa verborum, sed ratio vivendi. Nomina virtutum initia in anima designant.
pass_a_gloss: Who only history of-names follows, seed without cultivation leaves. Who with-spiritual art treats, tree becomes — not pomp of-words, but reason of-living. Names of-virtues beginnings in soul mark.
pass_b_english: Whoever follows only the history of the names leaves the seed untilled. Whoever works it with spiritual skill becomes a tree — not verbal pomp, but a way of living. The names mark beginnings of the virtues in the soul.
